description: This file defines the 'Lines' class, a utility for reading and handling lines from a text file, specifically designed for parsing purposes within the Android bug report utility.

classes.name: Lines
classes.description: A generic class for reading, iterating, and cloning ranges of lines from a file for parsing purposes.

methods.name: readLines(File)
methods.description: Reads all lines from a given file into a Lines object.

methods.name: readLines(BufferedReader)
methods.description: Reads all lines from a BufferedReader into a Lines object.

methods.name: Lines(ArrayList<? extends Line>)
methods.description: Constructor initializing Lines with a list of lines.

methods.name: Lines(ArrayList<? extends Line>, int, int)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a subrange of lines with a specified range.

methods.name: hasNext()
methods.description: Checks if there are more lines to read within the current range.

methods.name: next()
methods.description: Returns the next line or null if none are available.

methods.name: rewind()
methods.description: Moves the read position back by one line.

methods.name: rewind(int)
methods.description: Sets the read position to a specific index.

methods.name: size()
methods.description: Returns the number of lines in the current range.

methods.name: copy(int, int)
methods.description: Creates a subrange of lines as a new Lines object.
